ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Introduction to Design. This introductory design course focuses on theory and practice in the elements, processes and principles of design divided into three, five week workshops on the topics of: Materials/Craft, survey of fabrication techniques in various physical media; Color, study the visual, material and psychological/emotional nature of color; Communication, problems in communication using traditional and digital media. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. $95 Facility Charge.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
